reason: I don't pay for apps, period. The first summary is free and logging plus the basic doctor PDF stay free, so I'd grab the free one before my appointment and never upgrade.
objection: Predictions never work for my irregular cycles, and I don't even have a diagnosis or meds yet, so the 'what changed since metformin' part isn't for me. Why pay when Apple Health and my notes app are free?
would_change_my_mind: If the free summary actually got a doctor to take me seriously and order the PCOS workup, I might pay the $7.99 once for my follow-up appointment.
